scope: Independent bounded review of original controlling H decisions and actual local source before H network promotion; not acceptance of an unexported network.

controlling_requirements.source: Latest user PHASE H FINAL RESOLUTION, H-DECISION 3
controlling_requirements.rule: The same independent normalized zonal natural runoff driver applies to RoR and all other authorized natural-inflow classes. Distinct storage/turbine architecture, not manufactured temporal differences, distinguishes the classes.

controlling_requirements.source: Latest user PHASE H FINAL RESOLUTION, H-DECISION 6
controlling_requirements.rule: Preserve every hydro_id annual natural inflow MWh_water to <=1e-6 MWh; no change to NET turbine MW, efficiencies, annual water controls or class allocations.

controlling_requirements.source: Latest user PHASE H FINAL RESOLUTION, H-DECISION 7
controlling_requirements.rule: RoR p_max_pu is derived from zonal runoff with the same accepted annual-water/turbine-efficiency conversion. Fixed NET p_nom, no Store, no pump, dispatch curtailment allowed. Annual authority and installed MW must not change.

controlling_requirements.source: Latest user PHASE H FINAL RESOLUTION, H-DECISION 12
controlling_requirements.rule: Preserve annual MWh_water and turbine MW/efficiency; electrical output equals turbine water consumption times accepted turbine efficiency, applied once. The explicit Store state equation applies to water states; RoR has no Store.

controlling_requirements.source: Latest user PHASE H FINAL RESOLUTION, H-DECISION 13
controlling_requirements.rule: RoR p_max_pu is a permitted change only in versioned H successors. Everything outside permitted H transformations remains exact.
Use native local PyPSA-Eur hydro handling, preserve annual WATER rather than forced generation, make spill interpretation explicit, and retain fixed NET RoR Generator with no storage/pumping.

implementation_evidence.rule: Native RoR p_max_pu is inflow_t divided by installed RoR p_nom, with values above 1 replaced by 1.0. This is turbine saturation, not annual-profile renormalization.

Existing MEM conversion derives electrical = water * accepted turbine_efficiency, then divides by NET p_nom. It raises if >1+1e-10 before np.clip(0,1). The guard protected the formerly accepted temporal shape; it is not a separately sourced physical requirement that raw runoff can never exceed turbine throughput. This review does not authorize changing the frozen Runtime-1 files or historical outputs.

determination.reason: A fixed NET turbine cannot convert all natural water above its rated water throughput. Runoff peaks above that throughput are physically admissible and cannot be solved by increasing p_nom, adding a Store, changing annual water budget, or renormalizing the shape. Native turbine saturation plus explicit bypass is the exact component-level interpretation required by the accepted physical architecture.
determination.annual_water_authority: The full uncapped per-hydro_id natural-water series and its annual MWh_water remain the accepted authority. Capped turbine-accessible electrical potential is a distinct quantity and must not be represented as preserving annual potential-generation energy.

required_H_promotion_checks: All uncapped per-hydro_id annual MWh_water controls still reconcile at accepted tolerance.
All RoR p_max_pu are finite, nonnegative and <=1, without a secondary annual normalization.
Export hourly and annual turbine-accessible water/electrical potential and unavoidable bypass, including changed-hour count and maximum uncapped ratio.
Prove uncapped natural water equals accessible water plus bypass at every snapshot and annually with the accepted weighting.
Preserve NET p_nom, accepted turbine efficiency, zero Store/pump architecture and all non-H objects.
Do not weaken or overwrite frozen Runtime-1 input files or historical networks; implement this native mapping only in versioned H successors.
